M02-CAS.raw:


M02-BIZ.raw:
```sql

FROM lfz
JOIN lfz_typ ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr
WHERE lfz.stat = 'active'
GROUP BY lfz_typ.mdl;
```

M02-VAG.raw:
```sql
SELECT lfz_typ.mdl, COUNT(lfz.lfz_nr) AS active_planes
FROM lfz
JOIN lfz_typ ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr
```

M03-BIZ.raw:
```sql
SELECT SUM(entf_km) AS completed_departure_volume
FROM flug
WHERE abfl_ist IS NOT NULL AND abfl_fh = (SELECT fh_nr FROM flghf WHERE iata_cd = 'IST') AND stat = 'completed';
```

M04-CAS.raw:
```sql
SELECT flghf1.bez AS from_airport, flghf2.bez AS to_airport, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
FROM flug
JOIN flghf flghf1 ON flug.abfl_fh = flghf1(fh_nr)
JOIN flghf flghf2 ON flug.ziel_fh = flghf2(fh_nr)
WHERE flug.stat = 'completed'
GROUP BY flghf1.bez, flghf2.bez
ORDER BY flight_count DESC
LIMIT 5;
```

M04-SCH.raw:
```sql
SELECT f1.ort, f2.ort, COUNT(f1.flug_id) AS completed_flights
FROM flug f1
JOIN flghf f2 ON f1.urspr_fh = f2(fh_nr)
JOIN flghf f3 ON f1.ziel_fh = f3(fh_nr)
WHERE f1.stat = 'completed'
GROUP BY f1.ort, f2.ort
ORDER BY completed_flights DESC
LIMIT 5;
```

M04-BIZ.raw:
```sql
SELECT lgr.lgr_cd, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS completed_flights
FROM lgr
JOIN flug_ladg ON lgr.lgr_nr = flug_ladg.lgr_nr
JOIN flug ON flug_ladg.flug_id = flug.flug_id
WHERE flug.stat = 'completed'
GROUP BY lgr.lgr_cd
ORDER BY completed_flights DESC
LIMIT 5;
```

M04-VAG.raw:
```sql
SELECT flghf.bez AS departure, flghf2.bez AS arrival, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
FROM flug
JOIN flghf ON flug.abfl_fh = flghf(fh_nr)
JOIN flghf AS flghf2 ON flug.ziel_fh = flghf2(fh_nr)
GROUP BY flug.abfl_fh, flug.ziel_fh
ORDER BY flight_count DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

M05-CAS.raw:
```sql
SELECT AVG(CAST(SUBSTR(ank_ist, 12, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(SUBSTR(ank_ist, 15, 2) AS INTEGER) - CAST(SUBSTR(ank_plan, 12, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 - CAST(SUBSTR(ank_plan, 15, 2) AS INTEGER)) AS avg_late_minutes
FROM flug
WHERE stat = 'completed';
```

M05-SCH.raw:
```sql
SELECT AVG((strftime('%s', T1.ank_ist) - strftime('%s', T1.ank_plan)) / 60) AS avg_delay, T2.bez 
FROM flug AS T1 
JOIN flghf AS T2 ON T1.ziel_fh = T2(fh_nr) 
WHERE T1.stat = 'completed' 
GROUP BY T2.bez 
ORDER BY avg_delay DESC 
LIMIT 1;
```

M05-BIZ.raw:
```sql
SELECT flgesbez, AVG(CAST(REPLACE(SUBSTR(ank_ist, 12, 8), ':', '') AS INTEGER) - CAST(REPLACE(SUBSTR(ank_plan, 12, 8), ':', '') AS INTEGER)) AS avg_delay
FROM flug
JOIN flges ON flug.flges_nr = flges.flges_nr
WHERE ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND ank_plan IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY flgesbez;
```

M06-CAS.raw:
```sql
SELECT flgesbez, COUNT(*) AS cancelled_flights
FROM flges
JOIN flug ON flges.flges_nr = flug.flges_nr
WHERE flug.stat = 'cancelled'

```

M06-SCH.raw:
```sql

JOIN flghf ON lfz.heimat_fh_nr = flghf(fh_nr)
WHERE flug.stat = 'cancelled'
GROUP BY flghf.bez
ORDER BY cancelled_flights DESC;
```

M06-BIZ.raw:
```sql
SELECT flgesbez, COUNT(*) AS cancellation_volume
FROM flges
JOIN flug ON flges.flges_nr = flug.flges_nr

```

M06-VAG.raw:
```sql

```

M07-CAS.raw:
```sql
SELECT flgesbez, SUM(co2_kg) AS total_co2
FROM flges
JOIN flug ON flges.flges_nr = flug.flges_nr
GROUP BY flgesbez;
```

M07-SCH.raw:
```sql
SELECT flges.bez, ROUND(SUM(betankg.co2_kg / 1000), 1) AS avg_co2_kg

JOIN lfz ON betankg.lfz_nr = lfz.lfz_nr
JOIN flges ON lfz.flges_nr = flges.flges_nr
```

M07-BIZ.raw:
```sql
SELECT flgesbez, SUM(COALESCE(betankg.co2_kg, 0)) AS total_co2
```

M07-VAG.raw:
```sql

JOIN flug ON flges.flges_nr = flug.flges_nr
GROUP BY flgesbez
ORDER BY total_co2_emissions DESC;
```

H01-CAS.raw:
```sql
SELECT flgesbez, MAX(completed_flights) AS most_completed_flights
FROM (
    SELECT flgesbez, COUNT(*) AS completed_flights
    FROM flges
    JOIN lfz ON flges.flges_nr = lfz.flges_nr
    JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr
    WHERE flug.stat = 'completed'
    GROUP BY flgesbez
)
ORDER BY most_completed_flights DESC
LIMIT 1;
```

H01-SCH.raw:
```sql
SELECT bez, kennz, COUNT(*) AS flug_count
FROM flug
JOIN lfz ON flug.lfz_nr = lfz.lfz_nr
WHERE stat = 'completed'
GROUP BY bez, kennz
ORDER BY flug_count DESC, kennz ASC
LIMIT 1;
```

H01-BIZ.raw:
```sql
SELECT flgesbez, lfznr, COUNT(*) as completed_flights
FROM flges
JOIN lfz ON flges.flgesnr = lfz.flgesnr
JOIN flug ON lfz.lfznr = flug.lfznr
WHERE flug.stat = 'completed'
GROUP BY flgesbez, lfznr
ORDER BY completed_flights DESC;
```

H01-VAG.raw:
```sql
SELECT flgesbez, lfznr, MAX(gesflugstd) AS busiest_flights
FROM flges
JOIN lfz ON flges.flgesnr = lfz.flgesnr
GROUP BY flgesbez, lfznr
ORDER BY busiest_flights DESC
LIMIT 1;
```

H02-CAS.raw:
```sql
SELECT flghf.ort, flges.bez, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS landungen
FROM flug
JOIN flghf ON flug.abfl_fh = flghf(fh_nr)
JOIN flges ON flug.flges_nr = flges.flges_nr
WHERE flug.stat = 'completed'
GROUP BY flghf.ort, flges.bez
ORDER BY flghf.ort, landungen DESC;
```

H02-SCH.raw:
```sql
SELECT flghf.iata_cd, flghf.bez, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS count

JOIN flghf ON flug.ziel_fh = flghf(fh_nr)
WHERE flug.stat = 'completed'
GROUP BY flghf.iata_cd, flghf.bez
ORDER BY count DESC, flges.bez
LIMIT 1;
```

H02-BIZ.raw:
```sql

FROM flug
JOIN flghf ON flug.ank_ist IS NOT NULL AND flug.ank_ist <> '' AND flug.ziel_fh = flghf(fh_nr)
JOIN flges ON flug.flges_nr = flges.flges_nr
GROUP BY flghf.ort, flges.bez
ORDER BY flghf.ort, completed_arrivals DESC;
```

H02-VAG.raw:
```sql
SELECT flghf.ort, flges.bez, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS flight_count
FROM flghf
JOIN flug ON flghf.fh_nr = flug.abfl_fh
JOIN flges ON flug.flges_nr = flges.flges_nr
GROUP BY flghf.ort, flges.bez
ORDER BY flight_count DESC
LIMIT 1;
```

H04-CAS.raw:
```sql
SELECT 
  strftime('%Y-%m', flug.ank_ist) AS month, 
  COUNT(*) AS flights_completed, 
  LAG(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', flug.ank_ist)) - COUNT(*) AS change
FROM 
  flug
WHERE 
  flug.stat = 'completed'
GROUP BY 
  strftime('%Y-%m', flug.ank_ist)
ORDER BY 
  month;
```

H04-SCH.raw:
```sql
SELECT 
  strftime('%Y-%m', abfl_ist) AS month, 
  COUNT(*) AS completed_flights, 
  LAG(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', abfl_ist)) - COUNT(*) AS diff_to_previous_month
FROM 
  flug
WHERE 
  stat = 'completed'
GROUP BY 
  strftime('%Y-%m', abfl_ist)
ORDER BY 
  month;
```

H04-BIZ.raw:
```sql
SELECT 
  strftime('%Y-%m', flug.abfl_ist) AS month,
  COUNT(*) AS completed_flights,
  LAG(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', flug.abfl_ist)) - COUNT(*) AS month_over_month_change

  flug.stat = 'completed'
GROUP BY 
  strftime('%Y-%m', flug.abfl_ist)

  month;
```

H05-CAS.raw:
```sql
SELECT lfz.kennz, AVG(SUBSTR(flg.ank_ist, 1, 10) - SUBSTR(flg.abfl_ist, 1, 10)) AS avg_ground_time
FROM lfz
JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr
WHERE flug.stat = 'completed'
GROUP BY lfz.kennz
ORDER BY avg_ground_time ASC
LIMIT 5;
```

H05-SCH.raw:
```sql
SELECT lfz.kennz, AVG((julianday(flg.abfl_ist) - julianday(flg.ank_ist)) * 24) AS avg_time_diff
FROM lfz
JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr
WHERE flug.stat = 'completed'
GROUP BY lfz.kennz
ORDER BY avg_time_diff ASC
LIMIT 5;
```

H05-BIZ.raw:
```sql
SELECT lfz.kennz, AVG(julianday(flg.ank_ist) - julianday(flg.abfl_ist)) AS avg_turnaround
FROM lfz
JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr
WHERE flug.stat = 'completed'
GROUP BY lfz.kennz
ORDER BY avg_turnaround ASC
LIMIT 5;
```

H05-VAG.raw:
```sql
SELECT flug_id, abfl_ist, ank_ist, strftime('%J', ank_ist) - strftime('%J', abfl_ist) AS turnaround_days
FROM flug
WHERE stat = 'completed'
ORDER BY turnaround_days ASC
LIMIT 10;
```

H06-CAS.raw:
```sql
SELECT kunnr, SUM(brutto_usd) AS total_invoiced, (SUM(brutto_usd) / (SELECT SUM(brutto_usd) FROM rech_kopf)) * 100 AS share
FROM rech_kopf
GROUP BY kunnr
HAVING total_invoiced > (SELECT SUM(brutto_usd) * 0.04 FROM rech_kopf);
```

H06-SCH.raw:
```sql
SELECT knd_stamm.name1, SUM(rech_kopf.brutto_usd) / ( SELECT SUM(brutto_usd) FROM rech_kopf ) AS avg_brutto_usd
FROM sndg
JOIN knd_stamm ON sndg.kunnr = knd_stamm.kunnr
JOIN rech_kopf ON sndg.sndg_nr = rech_kopf.sndg_nr
GROUP BY knd_stamm.name1
HAVING avg_brutto_usd > 0.04;
```

H06-BIZ.raw:
```sql
SELECT kunnr, SUM(brutto_usd) AS revenue, SUM(brutto_usd) * 100 / (SELECT SUM(brutto_usd) FROM rech_kopf) AS share
FROM rech_kopf
GROUP BY kunnr
HAVING SUM(brutto_usd) * 100 / (SELECT SUM(brutto_usd) FROM rech_kopf) > 4;
```

H06-VAG.raw:
```sql
SELECT knd_stamm.name1, SUM(rech_kopf.fracht_usd) AS total_revenue
FROM knd_stamm
JOIN sndg ON knd_stamm.kunnr = sndg.kunnr
JOIN rech_kopf ON sndg.sndg_nr = rech_kopf.sndg_nr
GROUP BY knd_stamm.name1
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;
```

H07-CAS.raw:
```sql
SELECT flghf.ort, SUM(sndg.fracht_gew_kg) AS total_cargo
FROM flghf
JOIN flug ON flghf.fh_nr = flug.urspr_fh
JOIN sndg ON flug.flug_id = sndg.ladg_id
GROUP BY flghf.ort
ORDER BY total_cargo DESC
LIMIT 5;
```

H07-SCH.raw:
```sql
SELECT flghf.ort, SUM(sndg.ges_gew_kg / 1000) AS tonnage, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(sndg.ges_gew_kg / 1000) DESC) AS rank
FROM flug_ladg
JOIN flug ON flug_ladg.flug_id = flug.flug_id
JOIN sndg ON flug_ladg.sndg_nr = sndg.sndg_nr
JOIN flghf ON flug.urspr_fh = flghf(fh_nr)
WHERE flug.stat = 'completed'
GROUP BY flghf.ort
ORDER BY tonnage DESC
LIMIT 5;
```

H07-BIZ.raw:
```sql
SELECT flghf.bez, SUM(sndg.fracht_gew_kg) AS outbound_tonnage
FROM flghf
JOIN flug ON flghf.fh_nr = flug.urspr_fh
JOIN sndg ON flug.flug_id = flug_ladg.flug_id
WHERE flug.stat = 'completed'
GROUP BY flghf.fh_nr
ORDER BY outbound_tonnage DESC
LIMIT 5;
```

H07-VAG.raw:
```sql
SELECT flghf.bez, COUNT(zoll_anm.anm_id) AS export_count
FROM flghf
JOIN zoll_anm ON flghf.fh_nr = zoll_anm.fh_nr
WHERE zoll_anm.anm_art = 'export'
GROUP BY flghf.fh_nr
ORDER BY export_count DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

H08-CAS.raw:
```sql
SELECT lfz_typ.mdl, COUNT(*) AS completed_flights_more_than_half_full
FROM lfz
JOIN lfz_typ ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr
JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr
JOIN flug_ladg ON flug.flug_id = flug_ladg.flug_id
WHERE flug.stat = 'completed' AND flug_ladg.abschn_stat = 'flown' AND flug_ladg.ges_vol_m3 * 1000 > lfz_typ.max_vol_m3 * 0.5
GROUP BY lfz_typ.mdl;
```

H08-SCH.raw:
```sql
SELECT lfz_typ.mdl, SUM(flug_ladg.ges_vol_m3) AS total_vol, COUNT(flug.flug_id) AS completed_flights
FROM lfz_typ
JOIN lfz ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr
JOIN flug_ladg ON flug_ladg.lfz_nr = lfz.lfz_nr
JOIN flug ON flug_ladg.flug_id = flug.flug_id
WHERE flug.stat = 'completed'
GROUP BY lfz_typ.mdl
HAVING total_vol > 0.5 * lfz_typ.max_vol_m3;
```

H08-BIZ.raw:
```sql
SELECT lfz_typ.mdl, COUNT(*) AS completed_flights
FROM lfz
JOIN lfz_typ ON lfz.typ_nr = lfz_typ.typ_nr
JOIN flug ON lfz.lfz_nr = flug.lfz_nr
WHERE flug.stat = 'completed'
GROUP BY lfz_typ.mdl
HAVING SUM(lfz.max_vol_m3 * lfz.max_nutzl_kg / (lfz.max_vol_m3 * lfz.max_nutzl_kg + lfz.max_vol_m3 * lfz.max_nutzl_kg * 0.5)) > 50;
```

H08-VAG.raw:
```sql
SELECT lft.mdl 
FROM lfz lft 
JOIN lfz_typ lftyp ON lft.typ_nr = lftyp.typ_nr 
WHERE lft.ges_flugstd BETWEEN lftyp.max_nutzl_kg / 2 AND lftyp.max_nutzl_kg;
```

```sql
SELECT lfz_nr FROM lfz WHERE heimat_fh_nr IN (SELECT fh_nr FROM flghf WHERE hub_kz = 1) GROUP BY lfz_nr HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT heimat_fh_nr) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flghf WHERE hub_kz = 1)
```

H09-SCH.raw:
```sql
SELECT kennz FROM lfz WHERE lfz_nr IN (SELECT flug_id FROM flug WHERE abfl_fh IN (SELECT fh_nr FROM flghf WHERE hub_kz = 1) AND stat = 'completed') GROUP BY kennz HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT abfl_fh) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM flghf WHERE hub_kz = 1)
```

H10-CAS.raw:
```sql
SELECT zoll_land, COUNT(*) AS freq
FROM zoll_anm
WHERE (zollwert_usd * (zollsatz_pct + eust_usd / zollwert_usd)) / zollwert_usd > 0.2
GROUP BY zoll_land;
```

H10-SCH.raw:
```sql
SELECT zoll_land, COUNT(*) AS import_count
FROM zoll_anm
WHERE anm_art = 'import' AND (zoll_betr_usd + eust_usd) > 0.2 * zollwert_usd
GROUP BY zoll_land;
```

H10-VAG.raw: SELECT zoll_land FROM zoll_anm WHERE zollsatz_pct > 20 ORDER BY zollsatz_pct DESC LIMIT 10
